title: An ultra-bright, highly-scalable, squeezed light source for hybrid quantum photonics
summary: Hybrid quantum photonics seeks to combine the complementary advantages of continuous- and discrete-variable quantum optics. This typically entails photon-counting measurements on entangled states generated by interfering many single-mode squeezed-vacuum (SMSV) states. However, because conventional photon-counting schemes are mode-insensitive, it is critical that the SMSV states occupy a single, well-defined mode.
